properties.summary: Illustrative massing: West Midway's six land-use blocks are drawn to the height limits in its 2023 Development Plan (40 ft; 50 ft for the 4-story condominiums), over whole blocks, not as building designs, and RESHAP's residential buildings are drawn from its 2023 land use diagram at the plan's 50-ft limit. Streets, paseos, parks, parking and RESHAP's small shelter and community buildings aren't drawn.
properties.note: Blocks are drawn to their height limits, not as building designs.

controls.label: West Midway block outlines to the Tract 8696 lots: trimmed RMS over the closest 60% of 4219 points
RESHAP campus outline to the RESHAP lots: trimmed RMS over the closest 60% of 692 points

reshap_p13.printed_scale_check: fitted 0.1005 m/px against the printed 1" = 100' (0.1016 m/px at 300 dpi): -1.1%

properties.license: Shapes traced from public City of Alameda records, fitted to Alameda County Assessor parcels (county disclaimer).

properties.label: 3-story duets
properties.source: illustrative: drawn to the 40-ft limit printed in the block on West Midway Development Plan (Brookfield Properties and Catellus, May 4, 2023), approved May 22, 2023, sheet 10, Land Use Diagram & Building Heights (https://legistar1.granicus.com/alameda/attachments/5be8021b-f3c6-4a76-8312-60267b458f36.pdf); block traced from the same sheet
properties.note: 60 homes in 30 three-story duet buildings; eaves 30 ft, roof-deck stair towers up to 45 ft. Phase A's buildings passed design review on Dec 8, 2025.

properties.label: RESHAP supportive housing
properties.source: illustrative: the "Residential flats" and "Resident services" buildings traced from RESHAP Development Plan (May 8, 2023), approved by the Planning Board on May 8, 2023, p. 13, Landuse Diagram (https://legistar1.granicus.com/alameda/attachments/d3ee17a1-dd9a-4874-99d4-ae7134ed1c5b.pdf), drawn to its "ALL BUILDING HEIGHTS LIMITED TO +/- 50' HEIGHT"
properties.note: 332 homes in four buildings of up to four stories (the plan's 309, raised to 332 in December 2023 without changing the footprints or heights). Phase 1 is Stardust Gardens (80 homes) and Harbor Village; the 1- and 2-story shelter and community buildings aren't drawn.
